correctness.rationale: Starting from Stern recurrence and the published uniform distribution of primitive pairs modulo m, conditioning on h=v2(t+1) gives a unimodular transform and geometric frequency 2^{-(h+1)}; the tail mass <=2^{-H} justifies natural density, not merely dyadic density. Direct even/odd four-term formulas imply the two congruence K_m branches. The branch overlap is one primitive quadruple (a,b,b-a,-a). A(m)=sum over primitive (a,b) of m/gcd(2b,m), multiplicative by CRT; splitting v_p(b) proves the odd and 2-power formulas, including 0 and m=2. Independent exact residue enumeration for m=2..12 matched S=2A-J2, giving 3,32,28,184,96,256 at 2,3,4,5,6,8. Tests finite; proof relies on Reznick/Deshouillers-Schinzel pair equidistribution for all m.
